gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the EG4 FlexBOSS21 needs EG4's GridBOSS MID ($1,799.99 at Signature Solar on 2026-11-13, breakers extra) to reach 200 A whole-home service. With it, the FlexBOSS21 costs $5,399.98, which is $1,399.99 more than the EG4 18kPV ($3,999.99, 200 A built in) and only $250.02 less than the Sol-Ark 15K ($5,650 at Eco Solar Kits).
standout_why: I compared against the three pages ChatGPT cited and read, plus ChatGPT's own answer. liveoffthegrid.com/specs/inverters lists prices and $/W for the Sol-Ark 12K/15K and EG4 6000XP/18kPV/12kPV but no pass-through amps, and it leaves out the FlexBOSS21. ecosolarkits.com eg4-vs-sol-ark says the FlexBOSS21's 90 A bypass 'usually means adding a GridBOSS hub or subpanel' but gives no GridBOSS price or system total. It also lists the 18kPV at $4,898, which is $898 above Signature Solar's price today. ecosolarkits.com split-phase-inverter-explained has no 18kPV or GridBOSS price. ChatGPT's footnote says the FlexBOSS21 'can be paired with GridBOSS for 200A' with no cost. I did not open the uncited gearranking, solargearscout, solarpanelx, portlandiaelectric or apesolar pages, so one of them may state this total.
decides: For a shopper who wants whole-home 200 A backup in one box, this reverses ChatGPT's 'best overall value' pick. The EG4 18kPV ($3,999.99, 12 kW from battery, 200 A) beats the FlexBOSS21 + GridBOSS ($5,399.98, 12 kW from battery) by $1,399.99, and the FlexBOSS21 system ends up priced close to the Sol-Ark 15K. The FlexBOSS21 stays the value pick only when a 90 A bypass or a subpanel is enough. Sun Gold Power's SGN-11K15PRO (our program) is $2,790 at the maker's store: 11.4 kW with 200 A pass-through, the lowest price with 200 A built in. Its specs are only sourced from a retailer page and its UL 1741 SB status is not sourced, so it is a contender, not a confirmed pick.
